description: National Wastewater Drug Monitoring Program Reports is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission (ACIC). The National Wastewater Drug Monitoring Program commenced in August 2016 and provides national research and intelligence on illicit and licit drugs, with a specific focus on methylamphetamine and other high-risk substances. The Program is funded from the Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission’s (ACIC) annual budgetary allocation. The data in the reports show trends in drug consumption across Australia. Coverage is Australia, 2016 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-16. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
